title: Harden agent execution and grading
summary:
Improved agent reliability and grading consistency while preserving regression outcomes.

- Clarified tool-use and finalization policies to prevent unsupported restrictions and obligations.
- Added bounded result normalization and reconciliation checkpoints so final audits reflect returned state.
- Normalized grading scalars and recomputed aggregates for accurate adapter results.

Focused tests were added or updated but not run, as instructed.
